providers.title: The complete Crouzeix inequality (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For all n, m, every A in M_n(C) and every polynomial P with coefficients in M_m(C), ||P[A]|| <= 2 max over W(A) of ||P(z)||, where P[A] = sum A^k (x) B_k; the constant 2 is sharp. Proved in the last lesson.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Toeplitz–Hausdorff theorem
providers.scope: The numerical range W(A) = {u^*Au : ||u|| = 1} of a complex square matrix is convex; it is compact and contains the spectrum.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Outer approximation by sublevel sets (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For K compact convex and 0 < delta < 1, Omega_delta = {Phi_delta < 1} is a bounded convex domain containing K with closure {Phi_delta <= 1}, every point of which lies within delta(1 + diam K)/(1 - delta) of K.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Analytic polar boundary
providers.scope: Omega_delta is star-shaped about each of its points with a polar radius function that extends holomorphically to a strip; it is a smooth convex domain.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The Riemann map across an analytic polar boundary
providers.scope: If U is a bounded domain, star-shaped about 0 with analytic polar boundary, the Riemann map g of the unit disc onto U with g(0) = 0 extends to an injective holomorphic map on a disc of radius R_0 > 1, with nonvanishing derivative, mapping the unit circle onto the boundary of U.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Exterior coordinate of a smooth convex domain
providers.scope: There are 0 < r_0 < 1, c > 0 and an injective h(lambda) = c lambda + kappa(1/lambda) on |lambda| > r_0, kappa holomorphic on |u| < 1/r_0, mapping |lambda| > 1 onto the exterior and the unit circle onto the boundary, with Re(conj(q(lambda))(h(lambda) - z)) >= 0 for |lambda| = 1 and z in the closed domain, q = lambda h'.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Faber polynomials
providers.scope: q(lambda)/(h(lambda) - z) = sum b_k(z) lambda^(-k) defines polynomials b_k of degree k with leading coefficient c^(-k), given by an explicit recursion; they form a basis of the polynomials.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Separately holomorphic functions on a bidisc
providers.scope: A continuous function on a bidisc that is holomorphic in each variable is a double power series, with Cauchy estimates for its coefficients.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Mixed coefficients (OpenAI)
providers.scope: s(lambda, mu) = q(lambda)/(h(lambda) - h(mu)) - lambda/(lambda - mu) = sum s_kj lambda^(-k) mu^(-j) with |s_kj| <= C_rho rho^(k+j) for r_0 < rho < 1, and b_k(h(mu)) = mu^k + sum_j s_kj mu^(-j).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The positive kernel (OpenAI)
providers.scope: K = 1 + s + conj(s) is continuous and nonnegative on the torus, and both of its marginals equal one.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The coefficient estimate (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For G = sum b_k C_k with C_k in M_m(C), sum ||C_k||_2^2 <= the integral over the circle of ||G(h(mu))||_2^2 <= ||C_0||_2^2 + 2 sum_{k >= 1} ||C_k||_2^2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The resolvent and its positive Hermitian part (OpenAI)
providers.scope: If W(A) lies in the domain, R(lambda) = q(lambda)(h(lambda)I - A)^(-1) = sum b_k(A) lambda^(-k) on the unit circle, with ||b_k(A)|| <= C theta^k for some theta < 1, and R + R^* is positive semidefinite there.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The bound on a smooth convex domain (OpenAI)
providers.scope: If W(A) lies in a smooth convex domain Omega and F has coefficients in M_m(C) with ||F(z)|| <= 1 on the boundary of Omega, then ||F[A]|| <= 2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
